responsibility: This file supplies the host-side hook definition object for GCC builds that run on Darwin systems on AArch64/arm64 hosts. Its role is intentionally minimal: it pulls in the generic Darwin host support from config/host-darwin.h and publishes the host_hooks instance using HOST_HOOKS_INITIALIZER, with no AArch64-specific overrides, thereby selecting the standard Darwin host behavior for compiler runtime/host interactions on this host platform.
